quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常会在留出测试数据上表现很差，这种过拟合需要被减少 [p1]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 原文指出，过拟合的原因是特征检测器被调校为在训练数据上协同工作，而在测试数据上不能 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机将每个隐藏单元从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: We use the standard, stochastic gradient descent procedure for training the dropout neural networks on mini-batches of training cases, but we modify the penalty term that is normally used to prevent the weights from growing too large.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved to compensate for the fact that twice as many of them are active.
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 语音识别基准 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 语音识别基准 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: CIFAR-10 is a benchmark task for object recognition.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 语音识别基准 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 语音识别基准 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST（60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6]、TIMIT 语音识别基准 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 训练和 10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别数据集 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类数据集（训练和测试各 201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures and we then used the architecture that performed best with dropout on the validation set to assess the performance of dropout on the real test set.
claim: 对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者使用单独的验证集来选择网络架构，然后用 dropout 在验证集上表现最好的架构评估真实测试集 [p12]。

quote: Without using any of these tricks, the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，不使用 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提高到 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息方法的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network with five convolutional hidden layers interleaved with “max-pooling” layer followed by two globally connected layers and a final 1000-way softmax layer.
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误，在第六隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，标准反向传播的错误率为 31.05%，使用 50% dropout 后降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型产生更高训练误差，但实验表明现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重构为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections”
claim: 该形式通过前馈神经网络中的“捷径连接”实现，捷径连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。

quote: we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical
claim: 当输入输出维度不同时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 数据集（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，关注极深网络的行为 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: Table 8 and 8 show the object detection baseline results on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 and COCO.
claim: 此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测基线实验 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且整个训练过程中训练误差都更高 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
claim: 残差学习下情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
claim: 残差学习下情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上取得 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并在深度增加时表现出精度提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 错误率 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: yet is among the state-of-the-art results (6.43%, Table 6).
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并在深度增加时表现出精度提升，110 层网络达到 6.43% 错误率 [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p6]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相似，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，且该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 此外，作者提到深层普通网络优化困难的原因有待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿符号位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
claim: 其核心是多头注意力：将查询、键、值用不同的学习到的线性投影映射 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 作者采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 注意力采用缩放点积形式，即对查询与键的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和值 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]。

quote: $\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}(\frac{QK^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}})V$
claim: 注意力采用缩放点积形式，即对查询与键的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后做 softmax 并加权求和值 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS1.p3]。

quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以利用序列顺序 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦位置编码以利用序列顺序 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享源-目标 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步（12 小时），big 模型训练 300,000 步（3.5 天）[S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
claim: 作者还做了模型变体实验，在英德开发集 newstest2013 上评估不同注意力头数、键维度、模型规模、dropout 和位置编码的影响 [S6.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 此外，作者在英语成分句法分析任务上训练了一个 4 层、d_model=1024 的 Transformer，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 BLEU 的新最优结果 [S6.SS1.p1]；

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
claim: base 模型也超过了所有此前发表的模型和集成模型 [S6.SS1.p1]。

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model
claim: 在英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于此前所有单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 减小注意力键维度 d_k 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 用学习到的位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码，结果与 base 模型几乎相同 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote: our model performs surprisingly well, yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，模型在缺乏任务特定调优的情况下表现良好，除 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar 外优于所有此前报告的模型 [S6.SS3.p4]；

quote: the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences
claim: 仅用 WSJ 40K 句训练时，Transformer 也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
claim: 作者指出，自注意力在关联任意两个位置时操作数降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，因为注意力加权位置被平均，作者用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制为只考虑以输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部、受限的注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：大型预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务特定架构，且难以提供决策溯源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 作者探索一种通用微调方法，将预训练参数记忆与非参数记忆结合用于语言生成 [abstract]。

quote: Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.
claim: 其动机是混合模型可直接修订和扩展知识，且访问的知识可被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含两个组件：检索器 p_η(z|x) 返回 top-K 文本段落分布，生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1}) 基于前文、输入和检索段落生成当前 token [S2.p1]。

quote: To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
claim: 检索器基于 DPR 双编码器，生成器使用 BART-large，两者联合端到端训练，将检索文档视为隐变量 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
claim: 检索器基于 DPR 双编码器，生成器使用 BART-large，两者联合端到端训练，将检索文档视为隐变量 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.

claim: 消融实验显示，迭代搜索界面因 agent 穷举查看结果反而比无搜索工具更差（15.7% vs 12.0%）[S5.SS1.p3]；

quote: Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
claim: 无文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p4]；

quote: SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，随后进入“编辑-执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；

quote: Remaining turns are mostly “edit, then execute" loops.
claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，随后进入“编辑-执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；

quote: out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
claim: 51.7% 的轨迹出现至少一次编辑失败，单次失败后最终成功概率从 90.5% 降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]；

quote: We observe that successful runs complete earlier and at a cheaper cost than unsuccessful ones.
claim: 成功运行比失败运行更早、更便宜地结束 [S5.SS2.p5]；

quote: about half ( $52.0$ %) of unresolved instances fall into the Incorrect Implementation or Overly Specific Implementation categories
claim: 约一半未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

quote: Our main goal is to develop a rich body of theoretical connections between structured SSMs and variants of attention.
claim: 论文旨在建立结构化SSM与注意力变体之间的理论联系，从而将原本为Transformer开发的算法与系统优化迁移到SSM上 [S1.p2]。

quote: the development of SSMs have appeared disjoint from the community’s collective effort to improve Transformers
claim: 作者指出，SSM的发展与社区改进Transformer的努力显得脱节，导致SSM比Transformer更难理解和实验，且从算法和系统角度都难以像Transformer那样高效训练 [S1.p1]。

quote: the sequence transformation operator SSM ( Definition 2.2) coincides with the matrix construction operator SSS ( Definition 3.2)
claim: 论文通过结构化矩阵抽象建立SSD框架，证明状态空间模型等价于半可分矩阵，并给出其顺序半可分（SSS）表示 [S3.SS3.p3]。

quote: All that is necessary for linear attention to be fast is for L to be a structured matrix
claim: 作者用张量收缩语言重新推导线性注意力，并将其推广为结构化掩码注意力（SMA），其中掩码L可以是任意具有快速矩阵乘法的结构化矩阵 [S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: state space models with scalar-identity structure on the A matrices, and structured masked attention with 1-semiseparable structure on its L mask – are duals of each other
claim: 论文进一步证明标量-恒等结构的SSM与1-半可分SMA互为对偶，具有相同的线性与二次形式 [S5.SS3.p1]。

quote: we perform a block decomposition of the matrix. The diagonal blocks can be computed using the dual attention mode
claim: 基于此，作者提出基于半可分矩阵块分解的SSD算法，对角块用二次注意力模式计算，非对角块利用低秩结构归约为更小的递归 [S6.p4]。

quote: We compare on a challenging version of the MQAR setup from, using a harder task, longer sequences, and smaller models.
claim: 论文在合成多查询关联召回（MQAR）任务上评估Mamba-2，使用比先前更难的任务设置、更长序列和更小模型 [S9.SS1.p2]。

quote: The model sizes (depth and width) follow GPT3 specifications, from 125m to 2.7B. We use the Pile dataset
claim: 在语言建模方面，模型规模从约125M到2.7B参数，遵循GPT3规格，在Pile数据集上训练，并与Mamba及Transformer++比较 [S9.SS2.p1]。

quote: We benchmark the speed of the SSD algorithm against Mamba’s scan implementation and FlashAttention-2
claim: 作者还进行了速度基准测试，将SSD算法与Mamba的扫描实现及FlashAttention-2对比 [S9.SS3.p1]。

quote: Table 4 ablates these architecture changes to the block
claim: 此外，论文消融了块设计、多头结构以及注意力核近似等架构选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

quote: Table 5 ablates choices of the multi-head structure for the Mamba-2 architecture.
claim: 此外，论文消融了块设计、多头结构以及注意力核近似等架构选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

quote: We ablate several variants of these suggested by previous works in Figure 12.
claim: 此外，论文消融了块设计、多头结构以及注意力核近似等架构选择 [S9.SS4.SSS1.p1][S9.SS4.SSS2.p2][S9.SS4.SSS3.p1]。

quote: it is 2-8 × faster than Mamba’s fused associative scan
claim: SSD算法比Mamba的融合扫描实现快2-8倍，且从序列长度2K起快于FlashAttention-2 [S9.SS3.p1]。

quote: While Mamba-1 struggles on this task, Mamba-2 performs well across all settings.
claim: 在MQAR任务上，Mamba-2在所有设置下表现良好，即使在控制状态大小时也显著优于Mamba-1 [S9.SS1.p3]。

quote: Mamba-2 is Pareto dominant on performance (perplexity), theoretical FLOPs, and actual wall-clock time.
claim: 在缩放定律实验中，Mamba-2在困惑度、理论FLOPs和实际墙钟时间上均帕累托优于Mamba和Transformer++ [S9.F9]。

quote: For each model size, Mamba-2 outperforms Mamba, and generally matches Pythia at twice the model size.
claim: 在零样本下游评估中，每个模型尺寸下Mamba-2均优于Mamba，并大致匹配两倍大小的Pythia [S9.T1]。

quote: the main restriction of SSD is on the expressivity of the state transitions A_t
claim: 作者指出，相比先前的结构化SSM，SSD的主要限制在于状态转移A_t的表达能力，它采用更受限的对角结构，以牺牲表达能力换取硬件效率 [S10.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: the Mamba-2 model as a whole might not be as efficient to train as Transformer at short sequence length
claim: 作者还提到，Mamba-2整体在短序列长度（如2K）下训练效率可能不如Transformer，因为相同参数量下Mamba-2有L个SSD层，而Transformer有L/2个MLP层和L/2个注意力层 [S9.SS3.p2]。

quote: the kernel approximation methods we tried did not seem to improve over simple pointwise non-linear activation functions
claim: 此外，作者尝试的核近似方法未能超过简单的逐点非线性激活函数 [S9.SS4.SSS3.p4]。

quote: Generating novel active molecules for a given protein is an extremely challenging task for generative models that requires an understanding of the complex physical interactions between the molecule and its environment.
claim: 论文要解决的是在给定蛋白口袋内生成具有 3D 结构的新活性分子这一挑战，该任务需要理解分子与环境之间复杂的物理相互作用 [abstract]。

quote: However, it’s noteworthy that most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations.
claim: 作者指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具重建化学键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的分子图甚至使其断裂 [S1.p2]。

quote: However, the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach.
claim: 此外，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限 [S2.p5]。

quote: The key idea of our method is utilizing an autoregressive token generation model, influenced by GPT-based models, to solve several 3D small molecule generation tasks in one simple yet flexible paradigm.
claim: BindGPT 的核心思想是用受 GPT 影响的自回归 token 生成模型，把多种 3D 小分子生成任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。

quote: In our work we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX 1 1 1 Despite other architectures existing today (such as LLaMa2), our main focus was building a general framework of working with 3D molecules that can work with any Language Model architecture. architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings.
claim: 模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构和旋转位置嵌入，以支持序列长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: To alleviate that, we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format.
claim: 表示上把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 中去掉原子符号，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Thus, we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets.
claim: 训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 上监督微调，以及用外部对接软件奖励做 REINFORCE 强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

quote: During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020, which is a high-quality dataset containing aligned pocket-ligand pairs.
claim: 训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 上监督微调，以及用外部对接软件奖励做 REINFORCE 强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

quote: We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.
claim: 训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 上监督微调，以及用外部对接软件奖励做 REINFORCE 强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 12M 分子的 208M 个构象和 3.2M 个蛋白口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 上微调，作者过滤后得到约 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。

quote: For pretraining, we use a large 3D molecular dataset proposed by the authors of the Uni-Mol model.
claim: 3D 分子与 3D 构象生成任务还在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并以 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。

quote: EDM and MolDiff are task-specialized diffusion models for 3D molecule generation.
claim: 对比基线包括 EDM、MolDiff、XYZ-Transformer、Torsional Diffusion、Uni-Mol、TargetDiff 和 Pocket2Mol [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: we include the baselines such as 3D diffusion model (TargetDiff) and autoregressive Graph Neural Network (Pocket2Mol).
claim: 对比基线包括 EDM、MolDiff、XYZ-Transformer、Torsional Diffusion、Uni-Mol、TargetDiff 和 Pocket2Mol [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: First, the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不使用和使用显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: First, the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上取得当前最佳表现，但在药物相似性上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: First, the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在构象生成任务中，BindGPT 借助 RDKit 工具时可匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的表现，不借助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到 Platinum 数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: Our main conclusion is that the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
claim: 在口袋条件生成任务中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
claim: 作者指出，在药物相似性指标上 BindGPT 未超过 MolDiff，并推测这可能与模型词表较小、只包含常见原子有关 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness, that could be explained by a smaller vocabulary of the, containing only frequent atoms.
claim: 在构象生成任务中，不借助 RDKit 工具时 BindGPT 与 Torsional Diffusion 之间仍存在小差距 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: We believe the model quality can be improved further by increasing the amount of the data for pretraining and the current 108M model obtains the best performance given the pretraining dataset.
claim: 作者还提到，当前 108M 模型在给定预训练数据下取得最佳表现，并认为通过增加预训练数据量可进一步提升模型质量 [A3.p1]。

quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
claim: 论文要解决的是如何从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量大量恒星的自转周期 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。

quote: In this paper, we present a novel deep-learning approach for measuring stellar rotation periods using Kepler light curves.
claim: 论文要解决的是如何从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量大量恒星的自转周期 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。

quote: Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
claim: 经典方法（如 Lomb-Scargle 周期图和自相关函数）虽然成功，但耗时、难以应用于大规模数据集，且常难以处理具有多个周期或演化黑子图案的复杂光变曲线 [S1.p2]。

quote: One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
claim: 作者指出经典方法的一个缺点是难以给出预测的不确定度估计，而这对评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: Temporal branch - consists of an ”embedding” convolution block with max pool, dropout, batch normalization, skip connection, a bi-directional LSTM block, and a non-learnable self-attention block.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构：时间分支以 Diff-ACF 为输入，包含卷积嵌入块、双向 LSTM 块和非可学习自注意力块；全局分支以 Diff-Lc 为输入，基于修改后的 AstroConformer（用一次卷积加一次多头自注意力替代原两次卷积）[S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。

quote: Global branch - here we follow the recent work of called Astroconformer.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构：时间分支以 Diff-ACF 为输入，包含卷积嵌入块、双向 LSTM 块和非可学习自注意力块；全局分支以 Diff-Lc 为输入，基于修改后的 AstroConformer（用一次卷积加一次多头自注意力替代原两次卷积）[S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。

quote: The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.
claim: 两分支特征拼接后送入预测头，输出自转周期、倾角以及各自的置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
claim: 训练采用两步流程：先在 Kepler 样本上做自监督对比学习（SSL），再用模拟光变曲线做监督训练（SBSL）[S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
claim: 模拟数据由 Butterpy 基于简化黑子模型生成，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: Next, we injected noise from real Kepler data.
claim: 模拟数据由 Butterpy 基于简化黑子模型生成，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: The metric we used to evaluate the models is the 10 percent accuracy - the percentage of points with predictions within 10% absolute error from the ground truth.
claim: 作者在模拟数据上进行了消融实验，比较完整模型、去掉 Diff-Lc/Diff-ACF 的版本、仅时间分支、仅 Conformer 分支以及不预测倾角的版本，评价指标为 10% 绝对误差内的样本比例 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: To compare our results with we created another 50000 samples dataset, this time with the same prior distributions as in.
claim: 为与已有工作比较，作者另生成 50000 个采用相同先验分布的模拟样本，并使用 acc10p、acc20p 和平均绝对误差（天）作为指标 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: First, we downloaded the long cadence Kepler dataset Data Release 25.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 Data Release 25 长 cadence 数据，剔除 Q0-Q2 和 Q17，采用 PDC-MAP 校正，最终用于 SSL 和推断的样本为 130868 个 [S2.SS3.p1][S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 Data Release 25 长 cadence 数据，剔除 Q0-Q2 和 Q17，采用 PDC-MAP 校正，最终用于 SSL 和推断的样本为 130868 个 [S2.SS3.p1][S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: Out of the 130868 predictions we filtered out stars with $Teff<7000K$ which gave us 126029 samples.
claim: 推断时先筛选 Teff<7000K 得到 126029 个样本，再剔除已知污染源后剩 108096 个样本 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声和无噪声样本上的表现均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队报告的 ACF 结果 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 与作者自己实现的 ACF 和 GPS 相比，ACF 和 GPS 实际只预测了约 85% 的数据集，而 LightPred 预测了全部样本；在 ACF 可有效预测的子集上，两者 acc10p 和 acc20p 相当，但 LightPred 平均误差显著更低，且 LightPred 在所有方面都优于 GPS [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: The trend of high confidence and low error, which can be easily seen in the figure, implies that the model was able to infer which samples are ”harder” for it to determine the stellar properties.
claim: 模型置信度与绝对误差呈高置信度对应低误差的趋势，说明模型能判断哪些样本更难预测 [S5.SS1.p3]。

quote: Our model shows more concentrated distributions and when considering the entire samples (left panel), our model has much lower error.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，LightPred 的观测误差分布比 ACF 更集中，全样本下误差更低；在 ACF 有效子集上两者误差相当，LightPred 略低，相对观测误差平均均为 11% [S5.SS2.SSS2.p2]。

quote: While the improvement on simulation metrics is modest, the improvement on Kepler data is significant ( $\sim 3$ times lower observational error).
claim: 自监督预训练显著改善 Kepler 数据上的观测误差（约降低 3 倍）[S5.SS2.SSS2.p3]。

quote: For $3<P_{orb}<10$, sp samples are very close to the synchronization line (the gray line at $P_{orb}/P_{rot}=1$) as expected.
claim: 分析食双星发现，轨道周期在 3 到 10 天之间的黑子调制样本接近同步线，而 P_orb<3 天和 P_orb>10 天不显示同步 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p5]。

quote: This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.
claim: 最终经过筛选得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS3.p2]。

quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
claim: 作者承认模拟所基于的黑子模型存在倾角与黑子位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，黑子分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: We therefore treat inclination and period predictions separately; in this paper, we investigate the period predictions and treat inclinations as an auxiliary variable
claim: 作者指出恒星倾角测定比自转周期测定更困难，因此本文只研究周期预测，将倾角作为辅助变量，留待未来工作 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: We acknowledge that shuffling quarters (90 Days) might remove phase information and potentially hinder the detection of long periods.
claim: 在数据增强中，打乱季度可能移除相位信息并妨碍长周期探测，但作者认为其泛化收益大于潜在代价 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: While the latter is expected, the former can be assigned to the limitations of the model with very fast rotators, exactly as we saw in Figure 9.

claim: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多语言 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段 YaRN 将上下文从 4K 扩展至 32K 再到 128K [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1][S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: we apply YaRN for context extension and perform two additional training phases, each comprising 1000 steps, to progressively expand the context window from 4K to 32K and then to 128K.
claim: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多语言 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段 YaRN 将上下文从 4K 扩展至 32K 再到 128K [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1][S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains
claim: 后训练包括 1.5M 实例的 SFT 和基于 GRPO 的 RL [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Similar to DeepSeek-V2, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
claim: 后训练包括 1.5M 实例的 SFT 和基于 GRPO 的 RL [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Multi-subject multiple-choice datasets include MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, MMMLU, C-Eval, and CMMLU.
claim: 评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型及 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等闭源模型对比 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p2][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1][S5.SS3.SSS1.Px2.p1]。

quote: we compare the base model of DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V2-Base (our previous release), Qwen2.5 72B Base, and LLaMA-3.1 405B Base.
claim: 评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型及 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等闭源模型对比 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p2][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1][S5.SS3.SSS1.Px2.p1]。

quote: including DeepSeek-V2-0506, DeepSeek-V2.5-0905, Qwen2.5 72B Instruct, LLaMA-3.1 405B Instruct, Claude-Sonnet-3.5-1022, and GPT-4o-0513.
claim: 评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型及 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等闭源模型对比 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p2][S4.SS4.SSS2.p1][S5.SS3.SSS1.Px2.p1]。

claim: DeepSeek-V3-Base 在多数基准上超越 DeepSeek-V2-Base 和 Qwen2.5 72B Base，并在大部分基准上超过 LLaMA-3.1 405B Base，成为最强开源基础模型 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet
claim: 聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，性能与 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等领先闭源模型相当 [S1.p5][S5.SS3.SSS2.p1]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3 stands as the best-performing open-source model. Additionally, it is competitive against frontier closed-source models like GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
claim: 聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，性能与 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等领先闭源模型相当 [S1.p5][S5.SS3.SSS2.p1]。

quote: the MTP strategy consistently enhances the model performance on most of the evaluation benchmarks.
claim: 消融实验表明 MTP 策略和无辅助损失均衡策略在多数评估基准上持续提升模型性能 [S4.SS5.SSS1.p1][S4.SS5.SSS2.p1]。

quote: the auxiliary-loss-free strategy consistently achieves better model performance on most of the evaluation benchmarks.
claim: 消融实验表明 MTP 策略和无辅助损失均衡策略在多数评估基准上持续提升模型性能 [S4.SS5.SSS1.p1][S4.SS5.SSS2.p1]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3 costs only 2.788M GPU hours for its full training.
claim: 完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，成本约 $5.576M [S1.p6]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 此外，尽管端到端生成速度已超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍，仍有进一步提升的空间 [S6.p2]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 作者表示这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然解决 [S6.p2]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习在最小化人工标注依赖的情况下自我演化出推理能力 [S1.p2]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases
claim: 现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类提供的示例，无法探索更优的非人类推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework
claim: 作者基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 作为强化学习框架，奖励信号仅基于最终预测与标准答案的正确性，不对推理过程施加约束，并跳过传统的 SFT 阶段 [S1.p2]。

quote: Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 为解决 DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的可读性和语言混杂问题，作者提出多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we introduce a language consistency reward during RL training, which is calculated as the proportion of target language words in the CoT
claim: 为解决 DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的可读性和语言混杂问题，作者提出多阶段框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调，并引入语言一致性奖励 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024)
claim: 作者在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。

quote: For the training of DeepSeek-R1-Zero, we employed 64*8 H800 GPUs, and the process required approximately 198 hours
claim: 训练使用 64*8 H800 GPU，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 训练约 198 小时，DeepSeek-R1 约 80 小时 [A2.SS4.SSS4.p1]。

quote: we use a sampling temperature of $0.6$ and a top- $p$ value of $0.95$ to generate $k$ responses
claim: 评估采用 pass@k 方式，采样温度 0.6、top-p 0.95，AIME 和 GPQA 使用 k=64 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px4.p2]。

quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思、验证和探索替代方案等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: On math tasks, DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates performance on par with OpenAI-o1-1217, surpassing other models by a large margin
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在 Codeforces 上超越 96.3% 的人类参与者 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

quote: On the Codeforces platform, DeepSeek-R1 outperforms 96.3% of human participants
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在 Codeforces 上超越 96.3% 的人类参与者 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

quote: These distilled models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, surpassing the performance of their original instruction-tuned counterparts
claim: 蒸馏后的小模型表现优于其原始指令微调版本 [S1.p4]。

quote: the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models
claim: 作者承认 DeepSeek-R1 在结构化输出和工具使用方面表现欠佳，无法利用搜索引擎或计算器等工具 [S6.p3]。

quote: there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions
claim: 在 token 效率上仍有优化空间，简单问题上存在过度思考现象 [S6.p4]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages
claim: 模型目前针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]。

quote: it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance
claim: 此外，模型对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]。

quote: for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge
claim: 纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励黑客挑战，对于无法构建可靠奖励模型的任务（如写作），扩展纯 RL 仍是未解决的难题 [S6.p9]。

quote: large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks
claim: 软件工程任务因评估时间长，大规模 RL 尚未广泛应用，DeepSeek-R1 在该领域未展现巨大提升 [S6.p7]。

quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
claim: 其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但现有复现依赖大规模强化学习或海量数据 [S1.p1]。

quote: We collect an initial 59,029 questions from 16 sources following three guiding principles.
claim: 方法包含两部分：一是数据构建，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 个问题，经质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选得到 1,000 个样本的 s1K，推理轨迹由 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: Thus, we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
claim: 方法包含两部分：一是数据构建，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 个问题，经质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选得到 1,000 个样本的 s1K，推理轨迹由 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 二是测试时扩展方法 budget forcing，通过强制追加思考结束符来限制最大思考 token，或抑制结束符并追加“Wait”来延长思考 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We classify test-time scaling methods into 1) Sequential, where later computations depend on earlier ones (e.g., a long reasoning trace), and 2) Parallel, where computations run independently (e.g., majority voting).
claim: 作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B using basic hyperparameters outlined in §D.
claim: 训练方面，作者在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上用 s1K 做监督微调，使用 16 张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 训练 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），温度设为 0，指标为准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series, open-weight reasoning models with up to o1-level performance; Qwen’s QwQ-32B-preview
claim: 对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
claim: 消融实验覆盖数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 消融实验覆盖数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: budget forcing 使 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57%，但最终在六倍处趋于平缓 [abstract][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: it does eventually flatten out at six times
claim: budget forcing 使 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57%，但最终在六倍处趋于平缓 [abstract][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
claim: s1-32B 是最样本高效的开源数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 个样本就显著优于基座模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融表明，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致显著更差性能（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全量 59K 样本相比 1K 选择并无实质提升 [S1.p3]。

quote: Overall, we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.
claim: 测试时扩展方法消融中，budget forcing 提供完美控制、良好扩展斜率并取得最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
claim: 作者还指出，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 传统观点认为数学和编程等推理任务需要数万到数十万示例，并假设监督微调主要导致记忆而非泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型已在预训练中编码大量数学知识，挑战从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote: the threshold for eliciting complex reasoning is not dictated by task complexity but rather by two key factors
claim: 论文提出 LIMO 假说，认为复杂推理的激发阈值取决于模型预训练知识库的完整性和后训练示例作为认知模板的有效性 [abstract]。

quote: we implement a multi-layered filtering system: first conducting coarse difficulty filtering to eliminate trivial problems
claim: 方法包括严格的数据筛选流程：从大规模 QA 池中先做粗难度过滤，再做细粒度难度评估，并进行知识点多样化，同时按逻辑连贯性、步骤清晰度和解答正确性筛选推理链，最终得到 800 条训练样本 [S1.p4]。

quote: we implement a multi-layered filtering system: first conducting coarse difficulty filtering to eliminate trivial problems
claim: 作者使用 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行简单监督微调 [S1.p4]。

quote: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 论文在域内基准 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 上评估模型 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 分布外评估包括 OlympiadBench、中文新基准 CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool，以及多学科基准 Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准使用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%)
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；在 MATH500 达到 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；在 AMC23 达到 96.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基模型的 45.3%；在 CHMath 达到 84.2% 对 68.5%，在 GradeSchool 达到 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 显著退化（32.3% 对基模型 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上平均性能最高，为 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者指出，维持有效性能的最低样本量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: In this iteration of Qwen2.5-VL, we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: 论文旨在探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知差以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的架构由视觉编码器、基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器和大型语言模型三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.
claim: 模型将 MRoPE 的时间分量与绝对时间对齐，使模型能够学习不同 FPS 采样率视频间一致的时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等最先进模型进行对比 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Then, we evaluate the model’s performance across various sub-capabilities.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.p1]。

quote: we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.
claim: 在视频基准评估中，每个视频分析的最大帧数被限制为 768 帧，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超越此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在 MathVista 上取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最先进分数 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
claim: 在 OCRBench_v2 上，Qwen2.5-VL 模型在英文和中文赛道上分别大幅超过最佳模型 Gemini 1.5-Pro 达 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在 Charades-STA 数据集上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU 分数，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 论文指出，在将思维链推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管开发了基于规则和模型驱动的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤的准确性，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。
